sar.narrative: On November 17, 2016, a suspicious card-not-present transaction involving a new device was identified for customer C03042 using card id C03042-K1, resulting in an exposure of $599.94 under affected transaction ID T3464869. The flagged transaction utilized an anonymous email domain (anonymous.com) for both the purchaser and recipient emails. The customer's history spans both in-person and online channels, and the identity match status returned match_status:2. Furthermore, the customer has three prior closed fraud cases on record, indicating recurring vulnerability. Connected card IDs associated with the customer include C00681-K1, C05292-K1, and C11413-K1. There is no customer response on file regarding this activity. This pattern of card-not-present activity on a new device combined with anonymous email usage and prior fraud history is suspicious.
